# Mold Inspector Certification & Remediation Training

> Mold Inspector Certification & Remediation Training: 3 self-paced online courses from $59.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [Mold Prevention and Remediation Awareness Training](https://mold-remediation.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-218): $59.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA and EPA Guidelines. Enroll: https://mold-remediation.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=218. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/mold-prevention-and-remediation-awareness-training

In accordance with Federal OSHA and EPA Guidelines, Best Practice Recommendations by the AIHA, and IAC2 Mold Inspection Standards of Practice. - [Mold Inspector Certification for Prevention, Remediation, and Removal Training](https://mold-remediation.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-237): $329.99 per person, 6 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months.
